title: Co-op aiming round 2: deliberate flicks across six goblins, player 1 walks freely while targeted (DPC 0.9.172-dev9)
intro: Two controllers, both awake. A full party, open ground with room left, right and ahead, playing the Arisen, co-op off. Player 2 ideally on an archer or mage pawn (any works). Six tough goblins will be spawned (they cannot die). About 5 minutes. Press End (keyboard) when ready. Page Up reruns a test.

probes.mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cp and ((D.R.cp.on and D.R.cp.mode) or (D.coop.active and 'classic') or 'off')
probes.aim: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.cfg.coop_aim == true
probes.dbg: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.R.ta_dbg or '')
probes.p2t: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.coop.tgt_name or 'none')
probes.p2a: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local t = D and D.coop.tgt; local ok, a = pcall(function() return t and t:get_address() end); return ok and a or 0
probes.pin: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.pin ~= nil
probes.p1: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1 ~= nil
probes.p1set: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D ~= nil and D.R.ta.p1_set == true
probes.same: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; local a, b = D and D.R.ta.p1, D and D.coop.tgt; if not (a and b) then return false end; local ok, r = pcall(function() return a:get_address() == b:get_address() end); return ok and r
probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.flicks: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and (D.R.ta.flick_n or 0) or 0
probes.flick_mode: local D = _G.DPC_dbg; return D and tostring(D.cfg.coop_aim_flick or 'quick')

steps.text: Get ready (see the intro). Press End.
PLAYER 1: press something on your controller. PLAYER 2: hold L3 + R3 until co-op starts (player 1 the Arisen, player 2 a pawn). 25 seconds.
Six tough goblins: two on the LEFT, two straight AHEAD (further), two on the RIGHT. Nobody touch anything: player 2 gets an automatic target with a marker. 10 seconds.
PLAYER 2: tap R3 once: 'target kept', the marker gets a ring. 8 seconds.
PLAYER 2: move the camera around with the right stick slowly, all the way left and right. The ring should STAY on the same goblin (slow pushes are camera, not switching). 15 seconds.
PLAYER 2: now quick FLICKS: snap the right stick fully RIGHT and let go. Wait a second. Do it again until the ring reaches the rightmost goblin. 20 seconds.
PLAYER 2: flicks LEFT, one at a time, all the way across to the leftmost goblin. Count them: does each flick move exactly one goblin? 25 seconds.
PLAYER 2: tap R3: back to automatic (ring goes). 8 seconds.
PLAYER 1: point the camera at a goblin on the RIGHT and click R3: player 1's marker appears on it. 10 seconds.
PLAYER 1: DON'T attack. Just WALK: push up, then left, then down, then right, a few seconds each. The Arisen should walk where you push, NOT toward your target. 20 seconds.
PLAYER 1: now attack your marked goblin (attack buttons and skills). Hits should go to it. Then stop and walk away again: movement should feel normal within a second. 20 seconds.
PLAYER 2: HOLD R3 for a second: player 2 takes player 1's target (two markers side by side). 10 seconds.
PLAYER 2: flick once LEFT or RIGHT: player 2 moves off to a different goblin; player 1's marker stays. 10 seconds.
Both fight freely for 40 seconds. Player 1: switch targets with R3 on another goblin at least once. Player 2: flicks and R3 taps mid-fight. Notice anything that pulls you the wrong way.
PLAYER 1: click R3 on your current target: player 1's target released. 8 seconds.
Removing the goblins. PLAYER 1: hold L3 + R3 for 3 seconds to end co-op. 12 seconds.
Done (co-op aiming switched back off). Tell Claude: did slow pushes leave the ring alone? Did each flick move one goblin? Did the Arisen walk where you pushed while targeted?
